attchmntText: Travel Food Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release - Q2 FY27 - Un-audited Financial Results".
Travel Food Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Travel Food Services Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The presentation will be presented during an investors and analysts call scheduled for Friday, 13th November 2026 at 2:30 p.m. IST. The company reported consolidated sales of Rs. 4,253 million and consolidated profit after tax of Rs. 1,473 million for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. System-wide sales reached Rs. 8,654 million, representing an 18.8 percent year-on-year increase. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with a consolidated cash balance of Rs. 10,309 million as of 30th September 2026. The presentation is available on the company website at www.travelfoodservices.com.

attchmntText: Travel Food Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and copy of the Press Release.
voiceSummary: Travel Food Services Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. Consolidated profit after tax increased to Rs.1,473 million in Q2FY27 and Rs.2,761 million in H1FY27. System-wide sales grew 18.8% year-on-year in Q2FY27 to Rs.8,654 million. The company expanded its presence to 22 airports with 535 outlets. The balance sheet remains debt-free with a cash balance of Rs.10,309 million as of September 30, 2026. Passenger traffic declined by 4.8% in the quarter. The results are subject to the limited review report by M/s B S R & Co. LLP.

attchmntText: Travel Food Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet - Participation in Investor Conference
voiceSummary: Travel Food Services Limited intimates that its officials will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference on 16th November, 2026, starting at 12 Noon onwards in Mumbai. The interaction will consist of one-to-one and group meetings. The company confirms that discussions will be based on publicly available information and no unpublished price sensitive information will be disclosed. This information has been uploaded on the company website at www.travelfoodservices.com. The intimation is submitted in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015.
